﴿خِلالَكُمْ﴾ an adverb of place, attached to the verb, and the kāf is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the mīm is for the masculine plural; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf). ﴿يَبْغُونَكُمُ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil, and the kāf is the first mafʿūl bihi. ﴿الْفِتْنَةَ﴾ second mafʿūl bihi; the clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَفِيكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to an omitted khabar (predicate). ﴿سَمَّاعُونَ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative, the sign of its nominative being the wāw; the nominal clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl. ﴿لَهُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to سماعون. ﴿وَاللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ بِالظَّالِمِينَ﴾ its i'rab has preceded..

daas-irab:48-48.t: ﴿لَقَدِ﴾ the lām links the answer to the omitted oath. قد is a particle of affirmation (taḥqīq). ﴿ابْتَغَوُا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿الْفِتْنَةَ﴾ its object. ﴿مِنْ قَبْلُ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); the clause has no grammatical position, being the answer to the implied oath. ﴿وَقَلَّبُوا لَكَ الْأُمُورَ﴾ لك is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the verb; the verbal clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf). ﴿حَتَّى﴾ a particle of limit and a preposition. The interpreted maṣdar formed from the latent أن and the verb ﴿جاءَ الْحَقُّ﴾ after it is interpreted as a maṣdar in the position of genitive by حتى, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted verb, i.e. "واستمروا حتى مجيء الحق" (and they persisted until the coming of the truth). ﴿وَظَهَرَ أَمْرُ اللَّهِ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, and the Name of Majesty is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَهُمْ كارِهُونَ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate); the nominal clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl, and the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya).

daas-irab:49-49.t: ﴿وَمِنْهُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted, fronted khabar (predicate); the wāw is for resumption. ﴿مَنْ﴾ a relative noun in the position of nominative as a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject). The clause is resumptive, and the clause ﴿يَقُولُ﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿ائْذَنْ﴾ an imperative verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun ﴿لِي﴾ are attached, and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "أنت"; the clause is the maqūl al-qawl (what is said). ﴿وَلا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and لا is prohibitive, putting the verb in the jussive. ﴿تَفْتِنِّي﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the nūn; the nūn is the nūn of protection (wiqāya), and the yāʾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "أنت"; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf). ﴿أَلا﴾ an opening particle (istiftāḥ). ﴿فِي الْفِتْنَةِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to the verb after them; the verbal clause is resumptive. ﴿سَقَطُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿إِنَّ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya). ﴿وَإِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ لَمُحِيطَةٌ﴾ إنّ, its noun and its khabar, and the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); the clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial), and ﴿بِالْكافِرِينَ﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the khabar.

daas-irab:50-50.t:
﴿إِنْ﴾ conditional. ﴿تُصِبْكَ﴾ a jussive (majzūm) imperfect verb, the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and ﴿حَسَنَةٌ﴾ is its fāʿil (agent). ﴿تَسُؤْهُمْ﴾ the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), jussive, and the hāʾ is its object; the clause has no grammatical position, not being joined to the fāʾ or to إذا. ﴿وَإِنْ تُصِبْكَ مُصِيبَةٌ﴾ the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf).
﴿يَقُولُوا﴾ the apodosis, jussive, and the wāw is the fāʿil. ﴿أَخَذْنا أَمْرَنا﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is the maqūl al-qawl (what is said). ﴿مِنْ قَبْلُ﴾ قبل is an adverb of time, indeclinable (mabnī) on ḍamma because it is cut off from the construct; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿وَيَتَوَلَّوْا﴾ the clause is conjoined to يقولوا. ﴿وَهُمْ فَرِحُونَ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate), and the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); the clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial).

daas-irab:51-51.t:
﴿قُلْ﴾ an imperative verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun; the clause is resumptive. ﴿لَنْ يُصِيبَنا﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by لن, and نا is an attached pronoun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿ما﴾ a relative noun in the position of nominative as fāʿil; the clause is the maqūl al-qawl (what is said). ﴿كَتَبَ اللَّهُ لَنا﴾ a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached, and the Name of Majesty is its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun and has no grammatical position. ﴿هُوَ﴾ a detached pronoun, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿مَوْلانا﴾ a nominative khabar (predicate), the sign of its nominative being the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the alif because pronouncing it is impossible; the nominal clause is causal and has no grammatical position. ﴿وَعَلَى اللَّهِ﴾ the wāw is redundant (zāʾida), and a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb يتوكل. ﴿فَلْيَتَوَكَّلِ﴾ the lām is the lām of command, and a jussive (majzūm) imperfect verb; the fāʾ is resumptive.
﴿الْمُؤْمِنُونَ﴾ fāʿil; the clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:52-52.t:
﴿قُلْ﴾ the clause is resumptive. ﴿هَلْ﴾ an interrogative particle conveying disapproval and negation. ﴿تَرَبَّصُونَ﴾ its origin is تتربصون; an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). ﴿بِنا﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿إِحْدَى﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative, the sign of its accusative being the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif because pronouncing it is impossible. ﴿الْحُسْنَيَيْنِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive, the sign of its genitive being the yāʾ because it is a dual. The clause is the maqūl al-qawl (what is said). ﴿وَنَحْنُ﴾ a detached pronoun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject), and the wāw is a conjunction.
﴿نَتَرَبَّصُ﴾ an imperfect verb, and the fāʿil is "نحن"; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf). ﴿بِكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to the verb. ﴿أَنْ يُصِيبَكُمُ﴾ the interpreted maṣdar formed from أن, which puts the verb in the accusative, and the imperfect verb after it is in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi, i.e. "ونحن نتربص إصابتكم بعذاب.." (and we await your being struck with a punishment..). ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ the Name of Majesty, fāʿil. ﴿بِعَذابٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to the verb before them. ﴿مِنْ عِنْدِهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of عذاب. ﴿أَوْ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿بِأَيْدِينا﴾ the bāʾ is a preposition. ﴿أيدي﴾ a genitive noun (majrūr), the sign of its genitive being the kasra implied on the yāʾ, and نا is an attached pronoun in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; it is a noun conjoined to من عنده.
﴿فَتَرَبَّصُوا﴾ an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ implying an omitted condition), and the clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of an implied condition that does not put the verb in the jussive. ﴿إِنَّا﴾ إنّ and its noun. ﴿مَعَكُمْ﴾ an adverb attached to the khabar (predicate), and ﴿مُتَرَبِّصُونَ﴾ is its khabar. The clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:53-53.t:
﴿قُلْ﴾ an imperative verb, and its fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "أنت"; the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَنْفِقُوا﴾ an imperative verb and its fāʿil. ﴿طَوْعاً﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿أَوْ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿كَرْهاً﴾ a conjoined noun. ﴿لَنْ يُتَقَبَّلَ﴾ a passive imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb), and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is omitted, i.e. "الإنفاق" (the spending). ﴿مِنْكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. The clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl, i.e. "أنفقوا غير متقبل منكم" (spend, it not being accepted from you). ﴿إِنَّكُمْ﴾ إنّ and its noun. ﴿كُنْتُمْ قَوْماً﴾ كان, its noun and its khabar (predicate); the clause is in the position of nominative as the khabar of إنّ.
The clause إنكم كنتم.. is resumptive. ﴿فاسِقِينَ﴾ an accusative adjective (ṣifa), the sign of its accusative being the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural.

daas-irab:54-54.t: ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is resumptive; ما is negating. ﴿مَنَعَهُمْ﴾ a past verb and its object. ﴿أَنْ تُقْبَلَ﴾ a passive imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb); the interpreted maṣdar formed from أن and the verb is in the position of genitive by an implied preposition, i.e. "وما منعهم من قبول.." (and nothing prevented them from the acceptance..), or in the position of accusative as the second mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the verb منع. ﴿نَفَقاتُهُمْ﴾ nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿أَنَّهُمْ﴾ أنّ and its noun, and the clause ﴿كَفَرُوا﴾ is its khabar (predicate). The interpreted maṣdar formed from أنّ with its noun and its khabar is in the position of nominative as the fāʿil (agent) of the verb منع, i.e. "وما منعهم من قبول نفقاتهم إلا كفرهم" (nothing prevented the acceptance of their spending except their unbelief). ﴿بِاللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty; a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿وَبِرَسُولِهِ﴾ conjoined (maʿṭūf). ﴿وَلا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; لا is negating, without governing effect. ﴿يَأْتُونَ الصَّلاةَ﴾ an imperfect verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction. ﴿وَهُمْ كُسالى﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar, and the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); the nominal clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial). Likewise ﴿وَلا يُنْفِقُونَ إِلَّا وَهُمْ كارِهُونَ﴾.

daas-irab:55-55.t:
﴿فَلا تُعْجِبْكَ﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive; لا is prohibitive, putting the verb in the jussive. ﴿تُعْجِبْكَ﴾ a jussive (majzūm) imperfect verb, and the kāf is its object. ﴿أَمْوالُهُمْ﴾ its fāʿil (agent). ﴿وَلا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿لا﴾ conjoined to the first لا. ﴿أَوْلادُهُمْ﴾ a noun conjoined to أموالهم. ﴿إِنَّما﴾ a restraining particle and a restrained one (kāffa wa-makfūfa). ﴿يُرِيدُ اللَّهُ﴾ an imperfect verb, and the Name of Majesty is its fāʿil; the interpreted maṣdar formed from ﴿أن﴾ and the verb ﴿يعذبهم﴾ is in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object). [Translator's note: the verse reads لِيُعَذِّبَهُمْ; the source analyses it as أن with the verb.] ﴿بِها﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to (mutaʿalliq) يعذب, and likewise the preposition and its genitive noun ﴿فِي الْحَياةِ﴾.
The clause is causal and has no grammatical position. ﴿الدُّنْيا﴾ adjective (ṣifa); and the clause ﴿وَتَزْهَقَ أَنْفُسُهُمْ﴾ is conjoined (maʿṭūf). ﴿وَهُمْ كافِرُونَ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate); the clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) after the circumstantial wāw.

daas-irab:56-56.t: ﴿وَيَحْلِفُونَ بِاللَّهِ﴾ an imperfect verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached, and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِنَّهُمْ﴾ إنّ and its noun. ﴿لَمِنْكُمْ﴾ the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa). ﴿مِنْكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate) of إنّ; the clause has no grammatical position, being the answer to the oath. ﴿وَما هُمْ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); ما is negating. ﴿هُمْ﴾ a detached pronoun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿مِنْكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to the omitted khabar of the mubtadaʾ; the nominal clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَلكِنَّهُمْ﴾ لكنّ, and the hāʾ is its noun. ﴿قَوْمٌ﴾ its khabar; the nominal clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf), and the clause ﴿يَفْرَقُونَ﴾ is in the position of nominative as an adjective (ṣifa) of قوم.

daas-irab:57-57.t: ﴿لَوْ﴾ a conditional particle that does not put the verb in the jussive. ﴿يَجِدُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿مَلْجَأً﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause has no grammatical position, being initial. ﴿أَوْ مَغاراتٍ﴾ a conjoined noun, accusative, the sign of its accusative being the kasra because it is a sound feminine plural. ﴿أَوْ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿مُدَّخَلًا﴾ a conjoined noun. ﴿لَوَلَّوْا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, and the lām occurs in the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); the clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a condition that does not put the verb in the jussive. ﴿إِلَيْهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿وَهُمْ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject), and the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya). The clause ﴿يَجْمَحُونَ﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ, and the nominal clause ﴿وَهُمْ يَجْمَحُونَ﴾ is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial).

daas-irab:58-58.t: ﴿وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ يَلْمِزُكَ﴾ its i'rab is like that of the words of Allah the Exalted "ومنهم من يقول ائذن لي" in verse 50. [Translator's note: so in the source; that phrase is in verse 49.] ﴿فَإِنْ﴾ conditional, and the fāʾ is resumptive. ﴿أُعْطُوا﴾ a passive past verb, and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); it is in the position of jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the clause has no grammatical position, being initial. ﴿مِنْها﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted word which is the second mafʿūl bihi (direct object), i.e. "أعطوا بعضا منها" (they were given some of it). The nāʾib fāʿil, the wāw, is the first object. ﴿رَضُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a condition that puts the verb in the jussive, not joined to the fāʾ or to إذا. ﴿وَإِنْ لَمْ يُعْطَوْا﴾ منها like إن أعطوا.. ﴿إِذا﴾ the إذا of surprise. ﴿هُمْ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause ﴿يَسْخَطُونَ﴾ is the khabar (predicate). The nominal clause ﴿إِذا هُمْ يَسْخَطُونَ﴾ is in the position of jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). The clause وإن لم يعطوا is conjoined (maʿṭūf).

daas-irab:59-59.t:
﴿وَلَوْ﴾ the wāw is resumptive. لو is a conditional particle that does not put the verb in the jussive. ﴿أَنَّهُمْ﴾ أنّ and its noun. ﴿رَضُوا﴾ a past verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). ﴿ما﴾ the relative noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the verbal clause is in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of أنّ. أنّ with what follows it is interpreted as a maṣdar in the position of nominative as the fāʿil of the omitted verb of the condition, i.e. "ولو ثبت رضاهم.." (and if their contentment were established..), and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, its implied form being "لكان خيرا لهم" (it would have been better for them). ﴿آتاهُمُ اللَّهُ﴾ a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif because pronouncing it is impossible, and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi.
﴿اللَّهُ﴾ the Name of Majesty, fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿وَرَسُولُهُ﴾ conjoined (maʿṭūf). ﴿وَقالُوا﴾ the clause is conjoined to رضوا. ﴿حَسْبُنَا﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative, the sign of its nominative being the ḍamma, and نا is an attached pronoun in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ the Name of Majesty, khabar; the nominal clause is in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi. ﴿سَيُؤْتِينَا﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative, the sign of its nominative being the ḍamma implied on the yāʾ because of heaviness, and نا is mafʿūl bihi. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ the Name of Majesty, fāʿil; the clause is the maqūl al-qawl (what is said). ﴿مِنْ فَضْلِهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَرَسُولُهُ﴾ conjoined. ﴿إِنَّا﴾ إنّ and its noun, and ﴿راغِبُونَ﴾ is its khabar. ﴿إِلَى اللَّهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to the khabar ﴿راغِبُونَ﴾; the clause is what is said.

daas-irab:60-60.t:
﴿إِنَّمَا﴾ a restraining particle and a restrained one (kāffa wa-makfūfa). ﴿الصَّدَقاتُ﴾ a nominative mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿لِلْفُقَراءِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate). ﴿وَالْمَساكِينِ وَالْعامِلِينَ﴾ conjoined to الفقراء. ﴿عَلَيْها﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to the active participle before them. ﴿وَالْمُؤَلَّفَةِ﴾ a conjoined noun.
﴿قُلُوبُهُمْ﴾ the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) of المؤلفة. ﴿وَفِي الرِّقابِ وَالْغارِمِينَ وَفِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ وَابْنِ السَّبِيلِ﴾ .. conjoined nouns. ﴿فَرِيضَةً﴾ the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb, i.e. "فرض الله ذلك فريضة" (Allah has made that an obligation). ﴿مِنَ اللَّهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to فريضة. ﴿وَاللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٌ﴾ the Name of Majesty is mubtadaʾ, and عليم حكيم are its two khabars; the clause is resumptive.
